$comment: Aliases of the İBB 2017 table (data/footprints/ibb-mahalle.json) for the OSM join in scripts/data/footprints-merge.ts (rules.ts joinMahalle): "ILÇE" -> OSM ilçe name for a renamed ilçe; "ILÇE/MAHALLE" (İBB spelling, upper case) -> the OSM mahalle name(s) of a mahalle renamed since 2017, as "Ilçe/Name" when it moved to another ilçe. Only for names the generic passes cannot pair.
